items.title: Unit 5 · Story
items.prompt: Listen to the story. Which word fills the gap?
items.spokenPrompt: Listen. Which word fills the gap?
items.storyText: Two bees play in the sea. I like this leaf! I like this wave! I see a key. I see money. I see candy. I see... feet!
items.why: In “Bees in the Sea”, you hear: feet! The missing word is “feet”.
items.hint: Listen to this part again, or play the whole story.
items.sourceLabel: Oxford Phonics World 3, Unit 5, p.51 · Titi narration of the supplied textbook text
